interpretation: Counts use finalized archive bytes only. Partial finalized coverage is not a live prefix or a final benchmark result.
Provider schema acceptance, controller acceptance, latent action execution and numerical roundtrip accuracy are separate quantities.
Provider sidecars can omit subprocess calls killed before their final logging block; controller events are the attempt denominator.
Token usage sums only recorded provider usage fields; it is not a monetary invoice or an estimate for unrecorded calls.
Fallback windows partition actual fallback actions; provider-incident windows may overlap and must not be summed.
Following an HTTP or schema failure, a provider-valid retry can still fail controller subgoal validation.
No manual inference retry, controller change or workflow restart was made during monitoring.
